### [Ceftazidime–Avibactam Evidence-Composite PK/PD Modeling](projects/caz-avi-evidence-composite-pkpd.qmd)

A provenance-aware Monte Carlo framework that turns fragmented ceftazidime–avibactam evidence into simulation-ready PK/PD components — virtual populations, joint targets, PTA/CFR, calibration, and uncertainty analysis.

<div class="project-tags">
<span class="project-tag">Antibiotic PK/PD</span>
<span class="project-tag">AMR</span>
<span class="project-tag">Monte Carlo</span>
<span class="project-tag">Virtual Populations</span>
<span class="project-tag">Python</span>
</div>

<div class="project-actions">
[Deep Dive →](projects/caz-avi-evidence-composite-pkpd.qmd){.project-link}
[Repository →](https://github.com/piranfar/caz-avi-evidence-composite-pkpd){.project-link .project-link--secondary}
</div>

<p class="project-note">Methodological research framework — not a clinical dosing or decision-support tool.</p>
:::

### [AI Bacteriology Hub](projects/ai-bacteriology-hub.qmd)

A production-grade research platform combining a curated bacteriology knowledge base, an AI Research Layer for interactive AMR reasoning, and manifest-driven Python lab tools running inside a Docker sandbox on Google Cloud Run.

<div class="project-tags">
<span class="project-tag">Django + DRF</span>
<span class="project-tag">React 18</span>
<span class="project-tag">AI Research Layer</span>
<span class="project-tag">Docker Sandbox</span>
<span class="project-tag">AMR</span>
</div>
